name: Soundbeam 1
notice: Connect the controller MIDI output to a sound module or MIDI interface input. Use the original manual to configure range, pitch and MIDI settings for your hardware revision. The original family had hardware revisions; do not substitute Soundbeam 2 or 5 settings. Notes, channels and expression depend on the selected setup; this profile supplies setup guidance rather than a fixed note or CC map. Select this profile manually: port names have not been verified. The panel is an original conceptual schematic, not a scaled drawing of the physical controls.
